promptLatex: What is the sum, in degrees, of the interior angles of a convex hexagon?
hintLatex: A convex polygon can be cut into triangles by drawing diagonals from one vertex.
A hexagon needs $6 - 2 = 4$ of those triangles.
Each contributes $180^{\circ}$, so the sum is $4 \cdot 180 = 720$.
solutionLatex:
Draw diagonals from one vertex of the hexagon. That triangulates it into $6 - 2 = 4$ triangles, and the diagonals contribute no interior angle of the hexagon itself.
Each of the $4$ triangles contributes $180^{\circ}$.
So the interior angle sum is $4 \cdot 180^{\circ} = 720$.
